title: The DVFS loop and its leakage · ET-SoC-1
description: David Kanter described how a mature chip regulates its own power: an activity-based estimator inside a DVFS loop, and cache arrays behind leakage-suppression transistors. Checked against the ET-SoC-1's firmware source, its open RTL and the card itself: the loop reads a power meter rather than estimating power and, with no dead band, hunts at its 65 °C threshold; the open RTL has per-minion sleep controls, tied off, and the card shows no array power gating; leakage is 36% of a busy card, not his 5–30%; and a second card's firmware TDP of 0 W pins it at 600 MHz.
